Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent pixel-art SPRITE SHEET for an existing mobile tactical RPG. Create a NEW mechanical puppet called Cyclops, not a human. EXACT grid 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate full-body sprites with generous transparent gutters, no text, no frame borders. Every sprite fits wholly in its cell, same size and baseline. Pixel style must be REALLY COARSE: draw as if each character is only 36 logical pixels tall, enlarged with hard square pixel clusters; at most 16 colors, no gradients, no smooth illustration, no texture noise, no tiny rivets. Enemy palette: dark outline #1c2135, indigo metal #343552 #5c5d95 #8b86bf, small cold steel #bcc0d6 and teal. Design: compact headless round indigo armored chassis with ONE big teal circular camera eye set into its chest, short arms with violet wrist magic emitters, two short articulated legs with clearly different near/far leg shading. No face, mouth, nose, humanoid mask or second eye. The central eye is an auxiliary support core; wrist cannons remain functional when the eye is broken. View for EVERY cell is left-facing 3/4 SIDE BATTLE view (not front-facing).
Top 2 rows = eye intact, 8 poses in row-major order: 0 neutral standing; 1 near leg clearly forward and far leg back; 2 far leg clearly forward and near leg back; 3 both wrists raising and charging; 4 ONE wrist thrust forward left to fire, no floating projectile; 5 recovery wrist lowering; 6 kneeling collapsed; 7 lying disabled on its left side.
Bottom 2 rows = EXACT SAME 8 poses and same robot identity, but central eye glass broken away, a dark empty jagged socket with two visibly disconnected cables, NO teal glow. Preserve wrist emitters, legs and body size. Whole robot drawings, do not paste limbs or change viewpoint. Genuine transparent background, no shadows on ground, no labels, no white halos, no extras.

Top 2 rows intact engine, 8 poses row-major: 0 hovering ready wings half-open; 1 wingbeat up and claws folded; 2 wingbeat down and claws folded (genuinely distinct); 3 diving windup body leaning forward, both wings swept back; 4 melee strike ONE large talon lunges forward LEFT, wings balancing, full silhouette; 5 recovery claws retract; 6 sagging damaged landing wings lowered; 7 disabled on ground wings folded.
Bottom 2 rows SAME 8 poses, same owl and same full-body proportions, engine has ruptured dark casing and bent vent, no teal glow or jet; wings and talons intact and retain their articulation. Broken engine must be readable even at phone size and visible from this side. No detached parts, projectiles, flames, text or labels. Real transparent background, no floor shadows or halo.
